title: Death of Joshua
summary: Joshua son of Nun dies aged 110 and is buried at Timnath-serah; Israel serves the LORD all his days and the days of the elders who outlived him (Josh 24:29–31; Judg 2:7–9).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1424 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.date: "APPROX YEAR OF JOSHUA'S DEATH AT AGE 110 ... 20 YRS AFTER JOSHUA DIVIDED THE LAND AMONG THE LAST 7 TRIBES AT SHILOH. (1444 BC - 20 = 1424 BC)"
chronologies.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), timeline band
chronologies.note: Jones, 15th ed. (2002), ch. V p. 94: "1444 – 20 = c.1424 BC (year Joshua died)".

Ussher gives no year for Joshua's death: §340 (under 2561 AM, 1443 BC) says he lived at Timnath-serah "for many years" and died aged 110; §341 (2591d AM, 1413 BC) begins "After the death of Joshua and the elders who outlived him". Not inferred.

chronologies.date: "2585 - Death of Joshua at 110, assuming he was the same age as Caleb."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 51
chronologies.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry.

chronologies.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
chronologies.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). Question mark is Jordan's. 2001 keeps 2585.

chronologies.date: Joshua - 110 yrs. old, 2584 / 2585 AM, Josh.14:7-10; Jud.2:8, if about Caleb’s age
chronologies.citation: Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 3, chart "Genesis 12 – 25 Chronology of Abraham’s Life"
chronologies.note: Page 6 prints "2584 AM Joshua dies, if same age as Caleb, at 110 yrs. old". Differs from Jordan's own published figure(s): AM 2585, 2585.
